dietEvidence.body: The dentition and jaw apparatus support carnivory, but no gut contents or feeding traces are known. The prey species and hunting method are inferred from skull and tooth morphology, not observed.

sizeNote: Length and mass are estimates from incomplete material, not measurements of a whole animal.
tagline: A medium-sized tetanuran with a single median crest along the skull roof. The crest is a real bony structure; its function is not established.
summary: A medium-sized tetanuran with a single median crest along the skull roof. The crest is a real bony structure; its function is not established.

discovery.body: Named by Zhao & Currie (1993/1994). The holotype, IVPP 84019, preserves a skull, pelvis and part of the axial column from the Shishugou Formation, Xinjiang. It is not a complete skeleton.

fossilEvidence.title: Preserved material
fossilEvidence.body: A nearly complete skull and partial skeleton, plus referred material.

fossilEvidence.title: Stratigraphic and geographic occurrence
fossilEvidence.body: Shishugou Formation, Xinjiang records the species in the Middle Jurassic. The numeric range used here is ≈166–160 Ma, an occurrence estimate rather than a direct date on every specimen.

anatomy.title: Preserved anatomy
anatomy.body: The skull bears a prominent median crest formed by the nasals, and the postcranial skeleton is moderately built.

behaviour.body: The median crest is preserved bone, and display is a plausible functional hypothesis based on its size and position. No direct evidence shows a social or signalling function, and the animal’s vision and behaviour are unknown. No nest, trackway or associated assemblage is known.

reconstruction.body: A licensed life reconstruction is assigned to this record and credited in Sources and credits. The species is known from a nearly complete skull and partial skeleton, plus referred material. The reconstruction is an artist's interpretation of appearance, not a direct observation from the fossil record; preserved integument, where present, is described in the anatomy section, and the soft-tissue outline is otherwise inferred.

confidenceNote: Confidence is high for the skull and partial postcranial skeleton of IVPP 84019. It is lower for the crest’s function, the missing postcranium, diet and behaviour. The publication is dated 1993 in the journal but often cited as 1994, and the dossier preserves that inconsistency rather than silently normalising it.
